question: What is the meaning of fire rating of materials in relation to fire protection?
description: The fire rating of materials in relation to fire protection refers to the classification system that indicates how well a material can withstand fire or contribute to fire spread. Materials are assigned fire ratings based on their performance in fire tests, indicating their ability to resist fire and prevent its spread.
